meta.scope: Japan batch 2 — Deeper SBJ and related programmes, price/wage sources, structural surveys, Input-Output, prefectural accounts, and key BOJ producer-price series. Builds on batch 1 core (Statistics Act, SBJ, Census, CPI, LFS, Kakei, JSNA, Economic Census, Monetary Base, FFA, BOP, e-Stat). Definition locked.
meta.strategy_note: Continues NEXT-COUNTRY-STRATEGY.md hierarchy: national series → key source surveys → structural/quinquennial → subnational accounts. ~11 candidates.

candidates.title: Retail Price Survey (小売物価統計調査) — Trend Survey and Structure Survey
candidates.description: Monthly (Trend) and periodic (Structure) survey collecting retail prices of goods and services, house rents, and related charges at outlets across Japan. Primary data source for the Consumer Price Index. Also publishes retail prices of major items for Ku-area of Tokyo and nationwide uniform prices/charges.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics / core input to CPI. Monthly Trend Survey provides the price observations used to compute the CPI; Structure Survey supplies weights and detailed outlet information. Continuously referenced in CPI methodology and annual reports. Tokyo-area early indicators are widely watched by markets.

candidates.title: Employment Status Survey (就業構造基本調査 / Shūgyō Kōzō Kihon Chōsa)
candidates.description: Quinquennial large-scale household survey providing detailed structural data on employment and unemployment status, type of employment, occupation, industry, working hours, income, and reasons for non-participation. Complements the monthly Labour Force Survey with richer cross-sectional detail at national and regional levels.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics under the Statistics Act. Conducted every five years (most recent full results from 2022). Sampling based on Population Census enumeration districts. Results used for employment policy design, academic research, and as structural benchmarks that inform interpretation of the monthly LFS. Detailed regional tables support prefectural labour analysis.

candidates.title: Housing and Land Survey (住宅・土地統計調査)
candidates.description: Quinquennial survey of dwellings, households, and land ownership/use. Provides detailed statistics on housing stock, tenure, construction materials, facilities, residential land, and related living conditions. Fundamental statistics used for housing policy, urban planning, and as a structural input to national accounts dwelling services estimates.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics. Latest major results from the 2023 survey. Complements the Population Census with specialised housing and land detail. Data feed into imputed rent calculations in the national accounts and into regional planning indicators.

candidates.title: Monthly Labour Survey (毎月勤労統計調査 / Maitsuki Kinrō Tōkei Chōsa)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW)
candidates.description: Monthly establishment survey of employment, wages (cash earnings, scheduled and non-scheduled), and hours worked for establishments with 5 or more employees (national and prefectural surveys) plus an annual special survey for smaller establishments. Produces the official wage and hours series used for real-wage calculations and labour-cost analysis.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics (毎月勤労統計). Key source for nominal and real wage growth (the latter using CPI). Widely cited in BOJ Outlook reports, Cabinet Office economic assessments, and spring wage-negotiation analysis. National survey + local survey + special survey structure. June 2026 real wages showed continued positive growth driven by base pay and bonuses.

candidates.title: Corporate Goods Price Index (CGPI) / 企業物価指数
candidates.publisher: Bank of Japan (BOJ) — Research and Statistics Department
candidates.description: Monthly producer price index measuring price changes of goods traded among corporations (domestic corporate goods, export, import). 2020-base currently in use. Complements the CPI on the producer side and is a leading indicator for consumer inflation and corporate margins.
candidates.notes: Core BOJ price statistic. Continuously referenced alongside CPI in monetary-policy communications and in national-accounts deflation of intermediate consumption and gross fixed capital formation. Recent releases (e.g. May–July 2026) have shown elevated year-on-year increases driven by energy and related pass-through.

candidates.title: Input-Output Tables for Japan (産業連関表)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC) in cooperation with Cabinet Office, METI and other ministries
candidates.description: Quinquennial comprehensive Input-Output tables describing inter-industry transactions, final demand, and value added. Fundamental statistics used as the structural backbone for national accounts benchmark revisions, multiplier analysis, and environmental/energy extensions.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics (re-edited). Produced jointly under MIC coordination. The 2020 tables (and successive benchmark-year tables) are explicitly incorporated into JSNA benchmark revisions. Continuously cited in ESRI methodological notes and in academic/policy impact studies. Prefectural and multi-regional IO tables also exist and build on the national tables.

candidates.title: Prefectural Accounts (県民経済計算) / Annual Report on Prefectural Accounts
candidates.publisher: Economic and Social Research Institute (ESRI), Cabinet Office (standard methodology); compiled and published by each prefecture
candidates.description: Annual system of accounts for each of Japan’s 47 prefectures, compiled according to the Standard Method for Prefectural Accounts issued by ESRI/Cabinet Office and aligned with the national JSNA (2008 SNA). Covers production, income, expenditure, and related aggregates at the prefectural level. Also includes accounts for selected ordinance-designated cities.
candidates.notes: Subnational extension of the JSNA. All prefectures produce accounts following the national standard method; ESRI collects and disseminates the consolidated picture. Tokyo Metropolitan Accounts are a prominent example with detailed institutional-sector tables. Used for regional policy, fiscal equalisation analysis, and comparison of prefectural economic structures. Benchmark year currently aligned with national accounts (2015 or later revisions).

candidates.title: National Survey of Family Income, Consumption and Wealth (全国家計構造調査)
candidates.description: Quinquennial large-scale household survey providing detailed data on income, consumption, assets, liabilities, and wealth distribution. Successor/expanded form of the former National Survey of Family Income and Expenditure. Supplies structural weights and distributional detail that complement the monthly Family Income and Expenditure Survey.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics. Latest major wave is the 2024 survey (results emerging). Critical for understanding income and wealth inequality, for refining CPI and national-accounts household-sector estimates, and for poverty and social-policy analysis. Provides the distributional backbone that the monthly Kakei Chōsa cannot capture at the same depth.

candidates.title: Survey of Household Economy (家計消費状況調査)
candidates.description: Monthly survey focusing on expenditures on specific items (especially ICT-related goods and services, durable goods, and selected consumption categories) that are less well covered or more volatile in the main Family Income and Expenditure Survey. Also collects information on household ownership of selected durables and ICT equipment.
candidates.notes: Complements the Kakei Chōsa. Particularly valuable for tracking rapid changes in digital and durable-goods spending. Results feed into CPI weight reviews and into national-accounts private-consumption estimates for the relevant categories. Monthly releases with quarterly averages.

candidates.title: Services Producer Price Index (SPPI) / 企業向けサービス価格指数
candidates.description: Monthly index measuring price changes of services traded among corporations. Complements the Corporate Goods Price Index (CGPI) on the services side and is used in national-accounts deflation of intermediate consumption of services and in analysis of service-sector inflation.
candidates.notes: BOJ producer-price family member. Continuously cited together with CGPI and CPI in monetary-policy and national-accounts contexts. Provides the services counterpart to goods producer prices and is essential for comprehensive producer-price analysis in a service-dominated economy.

candidates.title: Master Plan Concerning the Development of Official Statistics (公的統計の整備に関する基本的な計画)
candidates.publisher: Cabinet (decision) / Statistics Commission / Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications
candidates.description: Cabinet-approved multi-year strategic plan required by the Statistics Act (2007). Sets priorities, quality targets, resource allocation, and coordination mechanisms for the entire official statistical system. Updated periodically (typically every five years or as needed).
referenced_by: Statistics Act itself (Article requiring the Master Plan)
Statistics Commission annual reports and deliberations
Individual survey redesign and quality-improvement programmes
MIC statistical-policy documents and budget justifications
International peer reviews of the Japanese statistical system
candidates.notes: Static strategic instrument that is recurringly cited as the authoritative statement of priorities for official statistics. Direct product of the 2007 Statistics Act framework. Each successive Master Plan guides the development of fundamental statistics, secondary-use expansion, digitalisation, and quality frameworks. Qualifies under the expanded node definition via continuous institutional citation.
